messages.author: c7a0d087ca7b2eb2
messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] shiny app for tracking israel elections in real time and comparing to past polling results
parts:
thanks for the feedback

the app is wandering around for now in small circles, not picked up yet.
- Maybe add block (left, right) aggregates? Or color/shape coding along block?
there are blocks, they are at the end of the dropdown lists, i need to float them up (you can see the options in the https://github.com/yonicd/Elections/blob/master/fac_vars.csv)
- There is no shape coding (aes) dropdown

true, due to space constraints i omitted that option.

i am checking now about adding a free text box that users who know ggplot can insert layers by themselves into the base layers.
- geom_line does not seem to work with discrete x axis. I thus suggest making continous x the default.

true. it was set to this because the geom_bar is the current default. the main idea was to not do aggregates of pollsters by default in order to help people understand the variance among them even on the same day of the poll.
- I am attaching a plot of what I think should be the default view

thanks for the suggestion, i may make it something like this. but the good part is that even if you dont like the default chosen you can get to nearly any cut of the data that you like best pretty quickly so the default isnt that important in the end.

i wasted an hour yesterday trying to create ci's for each time of geom dynamically... got a bit sidetracked but that should also be in the next upload (you can see the ground work for it in the server code)

thanks

yoni

messages.author: c7a0d087ca7b2eb2
messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] shiny app for tracking israel elections in real time and comparing to past polling results
parts:
thanks

i upgraded the app, it has a shinyAce input for open user code. https://yonicd.shinyapps.io/Elections/

now if you feel constrained by the default layout, you can really just make any plot you like.

the main data.frame is aptly called x and names(x) are in the dropdown boxes, so you can guess the right code to write.

e.g.

p+geom_bar(aes(x=factor(Ideology),y=Mandates,fill=Party),stat="identity",position="stack")+
geom_hline(aes(yintercept=61),colour="red",linetype=2)

enjoy!

nice plot, i dont like the output of the lines, but this is taste.

if you noticed the console can build on the gui generated layer but it is dependant on it. that is fixed now with a nice function

in the console add the first line (here it is a geom_point from the gui)
p=remove_geom(p,"point");
p+newlayer
